claims.claim_text: Architected the governed control plane for Unify's agentic AI platform, establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows across multi-agent orchestration contracts and audit-manifest lineage.
Directed CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing partner deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting to expand recurring revenue.
Built audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls across production agentic services.
Standardized the production adoption lifecycle for client AI systems, compressing delivery from six months to three weeks through managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.
Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms atop Databricks Lakehouse and dense-sparse retrieval, sustaining resilient agentic workloads at scale.
Commercialized reusable platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28, advancing an operating model for agentic AI productization across enterprise lines of business.
